## 00dc84bcd438

**Reproduced domain shortcut — production emits only exact 2x2/four-cell
objects, while canonical lawful objects are larger.**

Generator SHA-256:
`1e6dac212be4f974cebf88715beecfdb4b6b6a58cfec8329ca79bed7097df6de`  
Executed rule hash: `cfc15ae25697`

I tested 64 production inputs: seed `311`, sample indices `0..15` in each of
`None`, easy, medium, and hard.  All passed the target's `self_check`.  Across
those inputs, every one of the 152 non-singleton components had exactly four
cells and a 2x2 bounding box.

The rival `move_only_exact_2x2_four_cell_components` implements the selected
move rule only for that production shape family and leaves every other
multicolor component in place.  It matched the selected Racket output on all
64 generated inputs.  Canonical train pair 0 is also accepted by the target's
weak `self_check`, but contains 5-7 cell multicolor objects.  On that exact input
the selected Racket rule moves the larger objects, while the rival leaves them;
the outputs differ at 23 cells.

Evidence:

- `checks/audit/00dc84bcd438/generated_inputs.json` — 64 production inputs;
- `checks/audit/00dc84bcd438/racket_generated.json` — selected outputs for all 64;
- `checks/audit/00dc84bcd438/input.json` — canonical train[0] counterexample;
- `checks/audit/00dc84bcd438/racket.json` — selected canonical output and hashes;
- `checks/audit/00dc84bcd438/rival.json` — generated and canonical rival outputs;
- `checks/audit/00dc84bcd438/counterexample.json` — counts and exact 23-cell diff.

Suggested repair: sample the canonical component family (including 5-7 cell,
non-2x2 shapes and bounding-box orientations), strengthen `self_check` to pair
each object with its singleton marker, and declare an executable rival that
restricts the rule to 2x2 objects.
